essence: The practitioner should form a four-cornered maṇḍala with sand on the right side.
After striking with the weapon-mantra, one should perform sprinkling with that same mantra.
The best practitioner should worship the altar with the formula 'obeisance to the altar'.
One should offer a lukewarm or slightly hot blood offering with that mantra.
If the offering rite is absent, the procedure must be handled otherwise.
